title: Saligniac
summary: Raleigh names Saligniac in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Saligniac, also printed Saliniac, a traveller he cites on Capernaum and Decapolis. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VII, §. IV, subsection IV, sig. 225a–225b
